scope: 60-month/5-year scenario reconciliation, churn/acquisition targets, revenue/COGS/OpEx/payroll/cash/ARR, included+overage workload/price linkage, funding gap, cost sensitivity, zero-churn/input guard, phase coverage and documentation links
limitations: Financial inputs are assumptions, not actual demand/accounts or market quotes.
Cash timing, taxes, debt, capex and deferred revenue require a real accounting/board forecast.
No live product, customer acquisition, fundraising or production gate is certified by plan checks.
